svg.title: AstralBeam favicon
svg.desc: Two linked orbit rings crossed by a slanted beam of light.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam favicon construction: - Composite source: #astralbeam-rings and #astralbeam-beam from astralbeam-symbol.svg. - Colors match the dark theme tokens in packages/ui/src/styles.css: background #061014, foreground #edf8f6, and primary #35d6b0.
